reference_evidence_set.rationale: The 40-case coverage target was aspirational rather than a hard evaluation gate. These 30 cases have passed fixed-test-split membership, source-first verification, and the corrected content-alignment gate after the identifier-collision and self-match corrections.

E3_E4_outcome_prediction.reason: The frozen E3/E4 retrieval-and-evidence pipeline does not emit outcome labels; outcome prediction remains an E1/E2 measure.

authority_consistent_precision.population: final selected and displayed evidence items, not raw top-k candidates

result_finality.E1_E2_full_test_n1503: Final for this evaluation round. The deferred answer-key cases do not affect outcome-prediction metrics and will not trigger a rerun.
result_finality.E3_E4_answer_key_subset_n30: Final for this evaluation round. A future 10-case answer-key extension must be reported as a separate evaluation extension or round, not overwrite these frozen n=30 results.
